tvs.title-bl-seo: Lip micropigmentation photos – a sign of service quality
tvs.text-bl-seo:
Photos of lip permanent makeup are a deciding factor. They help you see whether you like the artist's work, the colors and the lip shape, and whether you'd like a similar lip tattoo. Lip permanent makeup photos also let you tell whether you've chosen a professional or a beginner.

After all, high-quality photos reveal every detail of the tattoo: how intensely the pigment was implanted, the shade and the final look. That's exactly why we recommend reviewing the portfolio of work before you book your lip micropigmentation.
tvs.text-bl-seo-2:
How can you tell if a tattoo artist is a beginner?

This is where photos of lip permanent makeup can help. If the portfolio has no photos, only a few examples of work, or you don't like them, it's best not to go to that artist. These signs point either to the artist's lack of experience or to cutting corners on materials, which will later affect the quality of the result or your health.

You like the lip permanent makeup portfolio. What's next?

If the lip tattoo photos catch your eye, feel free to book the procedure. As a result, you'll get the effect you want – full, luscious lips in a beautiful, vibrant, softly glossy shade.

  • In addition, lip permanent makeup helps you:
  • visually change the shape and volume of your lips, making them look symmetrical and full;
  • hide an unnatural color if your lips are pale or bluish;
  • cover pigmentation spots, freckles, scars, cuts, cold sore marks, etc.;
  • have expressive, seductive lips.

All you have to do is choose the technique. There are several options: aquarelle lips with light shading in pastel and nude shades; ombré lips with intense shading in light shades; and the ombré lips technique with a contour. You can choose the technique that suits you from the lip micropigmentation photos in the artist's portfolio, or consult the artist before the procedure. The artist will select the color and shade based on your skin's color type and then apply the tattoo to the highest standard.
